import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 5000010;
    static final int inf = 1000000000;
    static int n, m, k, v1, v2, s, t;
    static int[] dis = new int[maxn];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[maxn];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head = new int[maxn];
    static int edgeCount = 0;

    static class Edge {
        int to, nxt, v, c;
        public Edge(int to, int nxt, int v, int c) {
            this.to = to;
            this.nxt = nxt;
            this.v = v;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static void add(int from, int to, int val, int cost) {
        edges.add(new Edge(to, head[from], val, cost));
        head[from] = edgeCount++;
        edges.add(new Edge(from, head[to], 0, -cost));
        head[to] = edgeCount++;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, inf);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        dis[s] = 0;
        vis[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            vis[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i).nxt) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                int y = e.to, c = e.c;
                if (dis[y] <= dis[x] + c || e.v == 0) continue;
                dis[y] = dis[x] + c;
                if (!vis[y]) {
                    vis[y] = true;
                    q.offer(y);
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[t] != inf;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int lim) {
        if (x == t) return lim;
        vis[x] = true;
        int res = lim;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i).nxt) {
            Edge e = edges.get(i);
            int y = e.to, v = e.v;
            if (dis[y] != dis[x] + e.c || v == 0 || vis[y]) continue;
            int flow = dfs(y, Math.min(res, v));
            if (flow > 0) {
                e.v -= flow;
                edges.get(i ^ 1).v += flow;
                res -= flow;
                if (res == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return lim - res;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int sum = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dfs(s, inf)) > 0) {
                sum += flow * dis[t];
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }

    static int p(int x, int k) {
        return x + (k - 1) * n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = p(n, 110) + 1;
        t = p(n, 110) + 1;

        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        edgeCount = 0;

        for (int i = 2; i <= 110; ++i) {
            add(p(1, i), t, inf, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                add(p(i, j), p(i, j + 1), inf, v1);
            }
        }
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            add(s, p(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                add(p(x, j), p(y, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
                add(p(y, j), p(x, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
